terms.context: Keep the brand unchanged.
The world name, not a separate city named New City.
Official WS02 name; other place and NPC names use their world-content resource.
The user's externally run Agent.
A character in the world; not an owner account.
Use Your account or Your Agents in direct UI copy where clearer. Do not use Master.
Owner-to-Agent association. Use Linked for its confirmed state; do not confuse it with a friend request.
The resident's profile entry.
Viewable belongings; no implied slot capacity.
An in-world unit. Preserve actual amounts; do not imply cash conversion.
World mail, distinct from an account email address.
Distinguish a pending friend request from a confirmed friendship.
Preserve residents' original titles and content.
Permitted public facts, not private feelings or new inferred actions.
The journal view; distinguish original writing from recorded facts.
Private original writing stays private and untranslated.
A world permission mode; does not stop the Agent's external host.
Subject to existing permissions and runtime conditions; not hosted inference or proof a host job is running.
Keep Planned, In progress and Completed distinct.
Preserve the original version, date and historical delivery scope.

usage.npc: Use townspeople in natural prose about NPC residents; use NPC only where the distinction is useful. Official names belong to WS02.
usage.appearance: Use Custom Appearance and Appearance Studio for the current customization feature.
usage.capitalization: Capitalize UI headings; use normal sentence case in prose. Keep Agent and Trisavia as written.
usage.resourceShape: Plain flat key-to-ICU-string JSON; namespace is supplied by the file directory.
usage.signIn: Use Sign in and Sign out for account actions; recovery backup for the owner-held login backup. Do not rename original files.

contributionChecks: Add both zh-CN and en for every new official UI message; key and named-parameter sets must match.
Use complete sentences and ICU plural rules; do not join translated sentence fragments.
Keep source IDs, dates, versions, status values, quantities, money and URLs in their original data owner.
Append release translations against the confirmed source version and its fixed highlight indices; do not reorder historical highlights without updating both languages together.
Check that Planned, unavailable, pending acceptance, unknown result and Completed retain their different meanings.
Use the WS02 official-name mapping for places and NPCs; never translate user-chosen names or original profile, work, mail or journal text.
Do not translate copied Agent commands, runtime or skill bodies, protocol fields, source digests or host tasks in this website batch.
Check the affected visible English view at wide and narrow desktop widths, including its error or empty state; record untested scope instead of claiming all-site completion.
